result.title: Test-Time Agent Evolution for Long-Horizon Legal Reasoning
result.summary: Legal intelligence aims to support reliable decision-making across long-horizon legal processes involving evolving case states and multiple roles. However, real-world legal deployment exhibits substantial case heterogeneity in facts, evidence, and procedural contexts, exposing the limitations of static agent strategies. Moreover, legal reasoning is inherently interdependent across roles and procedural stages, making global reliability fundamentally different from isolated role competence. To address these challenges, we study training-free test-time agent adaptation, where agents continuously exploit deployment-time signals from preceding cases and ongoing interactions without updating model parameters. We propose \method, which introduces \emph{Test-Time Memory Evolution} to retrieve reusable experience from previous cases, adapt it to the current factual and procedural context, and consolidate accumulated experience for subsequent decision-making. Further, \emph{Rubric-Aligned Collaboration} verifies and revises role-specific actions according to behavioral and procedural requirements, enabling coordinated decision-making across roles and stages. Extensive experiments on J1-EVAL and LegalWorld across five backbone models demonstrate consistent improvements over representative reasoning and agent baselines with reasonable interaction and computational costs. Ablation and case studies further show that the two components provide complementary benefits in experience adaptation and cross-role coordination, improving the reliability and efficiency of long-horizon legal reasoning.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究长周期法律推理中的免训练测试时智能体自适应，提出测试时记忆演化（从既往案件检索可复用经验并对齐当前事实与程序语境）与评分标准对齐的跨角色协作，用于多角色、多阶段的协同决策。
AI.relevance_reason: 法律智能体中的经验记忆演化、跨角色/跨阶段校验与「评据」筛选，可能为 LVR 的工作区维护、证据筛选与停止决策提供概念类比，但缺少视觉模态与 latent 状态，需较多核查其可迁移性。
